nav.offline: Offline. Features that need the internet are paused; the rest are unaffected.

state.storageUnsupported: This browser cannot store the page's data, so nothing from this session is kept once the tab closes. Opening it in a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari allows it to be saved.
state.storageBlocked: This window does not allow the page to store data, so nothing from this session is kept once the tab closes. Opening it in an ordinary window rather than a private one allows it to be saved.
state.storageOtherTab: Breadcrumb is already open in another tab, and nothing here will be saved. Return to that tab to continue, or close it and reload this page.
